sense.text: The lesson of the day is Satan on Mount Sinai, the new global religion, and it opens in Exodus 1. “Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.” Before going on, the race of the Egyptians is dealt with first, because the children of Israel went down into Egypt and lived among the Egyptians, and the scriptures show the two looked alike.
“And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already.” Joseph was already there, and his sons were born in Egypt.

“Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.” Write it down at verse 8: a new dynasty. This new king is what they call a new dynasty, a new line of Pharaohs that did not know Joseph.

precepts.why: To deal with the race first: “And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.” Ham became the father of Cush, Mizraim, Phut and Canaan. These are the Egyptians and the nations around them, so what we are dealing with in Egypt is Hamites.

“These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.” When it says in their countries and in their nations, it means they multiplied and spread out into nations. The Egyptians Israel came down among are these Hamites.

“And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them.” Imagine it: Joseph is in Egypt, his brothers come down for food, and they do not recognize Joseph standing among the Egyptians. This is evidence that Joseph and the Israelites were always a black-skinned people.

They said “From the land of Canaan to buy food.” “And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.” Joseph recognized his brothers, but they did not recognize him. Why? Because he looked just like the Egyptians.

“And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.” He spoke to his brothers through an interpreter as if he did not understand the Hebrew dialect. He recognized them but they did not recognize him, proving Joseph looked just like the Egyptians.

Jacob had died, and Joseph asks Pharaoh: “let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.” “And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father”. With Joseph went up “all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt”, with the house of Joseph and his brethren, “both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.” A huge company came up out of Egypt toward the land of Canaan.

They came to “the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation”. Then verse 11: “when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abel–mizraim”. The Canaanites looked at the Hebrews and the Egyptians that came with them and said, these are the Egyptians. They could not tell them apart. What we are to see is that Israel looked just like the Egyptians, very similar.

Pharaoh “sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.” The priest of Midian’s seven daughters came to draw water, the shepherds drove them away, “but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.” When their father asked how they came home so soon, “they said, An Egyptian delivered us”. What did they say Moses was? An Egyptian, a Hamite. That is what they thought Moses was.

Even the scholars’ own Bible dictionary says Ham became the progenitor, the father, of the dark races, the Egyptians, Ethiopians, Libyans and Canaanites, while saying ‘not the Negro’, and the word negro comes from Spain. And under ‘ruddy’ it says the word refers to a red or fair complexion. The red part is wrong; fair complexion is the true meaning, good skin quality, no blemishes, no bumps. But notice what it says next: ruddy is in contrast to the dark skin of the Hebrew. The scholars know the Hebrews are dark skinned. See the contradiction: they put images of white people up as the Hebrews, but their scholars know he was a dark skin.

The name of the continent: “Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.” The word Ham in Hebrew is where the word Kem comes from. When they say Kemetic and when they say Hamitic, they are saying the same thing.
“They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.” That is the name of the continent that Ham took, what they call Africa. God called it the land of Ham.

Where does the name Africa come from? “Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever”. That is what you see when you examine their movies: it is always the new frontier, where black people are blind or have something on their head, there is always something wrong with us in the future, but white folks are always good.

“And their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.” When they conquer kingdoms they put on them the name they desire. All historians agree it was the Romans’ use of the term Africa for parts of Tunisia and northern Algeria that, almost 2,000 years later, gave the continent its name; it was Scipio Africanus that overthrew Hannibal in the Punic Wars. The point is, Rome put that name on the continent. That was Rome’s decision. God called it the land of Ham; Rome said no, we’re calling it Africa.

sense.text: Back to Exodus 1, for the treasure cities. “Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.” This new king refers to a new dynasty. The 18th Dynasty family tree shows them: these are the New Kingdom dynasties that enslaved us. Among them is Queen Nefertiti, the one black women love so much. She was a slave master. When the Egyptians died, all their slaves were buried alive with them to serve them in the afterlife. Our people are simple as hell. These were all Nilotes, Nilotic pure bloods.

He said unto his people, “Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply”, and when war falls out “they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.”

“Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens.” This lets you know we went into slavery; that is what afflict them means. “And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.” The images of the Valley of the Kings show how large these statues are compared with the people: these are the ruins and sculptures we had to build and carve out, magnificent, with the obelisk, and the images of Ramses there are black.

Ramses is the name of the Pharaoh we made our Exodus from. Some scholars say nobody knows which Pharaoh it was. No, the Bible tells you.

The images of the queens that ruled over us sit beside the images of the Israelites, and they are the same color. These are not European, not Caucasian women. They are Nilotes, pure bloods, and that is stressed because in some places people are of mixed blood, so be very careful. There are images of Israel in slavery showing their color, of the Israelites building the treasure cities, and of the Exodus with Moses delivering Israel, found near the Euphrates River from around 300 A.D., with the hand of God above Moses. How are you going to look at Moses there and say white man? These are black images, and this is the history they don’t want out in the media, because they have pulled that lie too long calling themselves the Jews. For these Europeans to say that they are the Jews of the Bible, that’s blasphemy.

precepts.why:
“And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.” Right there: we departed from Rameses in the first month, and they say nobody knows who the Pharaoh was.

“For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the Lord had smitten among them: upon their gods also the Lord executed judgments. And the children of Israel removed from Rameses”. All through the Bible it tells you Ramses: we fled from Ramses, we left from Ramses.

When that new king rose up, here is how long we were there. The Lord told Abraham something in the spirit: “Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years”. So we were afflicted in Egypt for 400 years.

That verse is talking about ancient Egypt. It is not talking about the United States of America, so stop saying that. Brothers say it, and it may have been said here one time, but it is wrong. It is talking about ancient Egypt.

Somebody will pull up this verse and say it is a contradiction. No, you’re a contradiction. “Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years.” The first 30 years we were under Joseph. There was no war; we were not afflicted. It was when Joseph died and a new Pharaoh came in that the affliction began, and that is the 400 years.

“And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.” It agrees: 400 years of bondage and affliction. There is no time for people looking around the Bible searching for contradictions. They are scorners; leave those spirits alone.

sense.text: This is Mount Sinai, where Moses got the laws and the commandments, and now the history behind this mountain. “And the Lord spake unto Moses in mount Sinai”.
“When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the Lord.” So on Mount Sinai we were given a law of the Sabbath.

precepts.why: “These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the Lord made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.” See it: statutes and judgments and laws. Statutes are sub-laws. It was not just Ten Commandments. In Christianity they teach that it took Moses 40 days and 40 nights to get 10 laws. That’s ridiculous.

“And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death. And he said, The Lord came from Sinai”. He “came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.”

“Yea, he loved the people”: for God so loved the world, he loved the people. “All his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.”

Still dealing with Mount Sinai: “Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spakest with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments: And madest known unto them thy holy sabbath, and commandedst them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses thy servant”. Judgments, laws, statutes, commandments, precepts and the Sabbath, all given at Sinai.

What else did Moses get while he was on Mount Sinai? “In the bush I did manifestly reveal myself unto Moses, and talked with him, when my people served in Egypt: And I sent him, and led my people out of Egypt”, and brought him up to the mount of Sinai, where he held him “a long season”. That long season was the 40 days and 40 nights.

He “told him many wondrous things, and shewed him the secrets of the times, and the end”. God showed Moses the secrets of the times and the end of times. “These words shalt thou declare”: that is the law, made obvious, made clear. And the others he was to hide, meaning write them as a parable, in a song, and make them a little more difficult.

So Moses received prophecy on Sinai, and that leads to Egypt in the prophecy that Moses received.

sense.text: Now Egypt in the prophecy that Moses received: in brief, the secrets of the times that the Lord showed Moses. “But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee”. If we break God’s commandments, curses will come upon us.

precepts.why: “Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.” If we break God’s laws we would not enjoy our children, because they would go into slavery. Moses saw that thing. These are the things the Lord showed Moses when he showed him the secrets of the times and the end: Moses saw the children of Israel going into slavery, captivity after captivity after captivity.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies”. Not friends. As a nation of people we must understand that when the Lord says enemy he means enemy. He doesn’t mean that one over there is a nice one. Brothers, and especially sisters, misconstrue it: some of you find one on your job who treats you well and say they’re not all bad. No, you’re stupid. The Bible says they are your enemies. God moved that one spirit to be nice toward you. That does not mean they can be saved. That’s not Bible.

The enemies “which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger”: your enemies will control the food industry; “and in thirst”: the water industry; “and in nakedness”: the clothing industry; “and in want of all things”: education, religion, medicine, property, you have to go to your enemies for it. Whatever you want, the Bible says you must go to your enemies for it.

“And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” The Lord showed Moses the secrets of the times, and Moses saw this. It did not happen to Europeans. The only way these yokes of iron came off our neck is when we were mentally and spiritually destroyed as a people. Hence we’re in Christianity, Judaism and all these other stupid, evil religions out here. The yokes of iron came off once we were mentally and spiritually broken as a people.

“And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships”. Moses saw this. That is what the Lord revealed to Ezra: I showed Moses the secrets of the times, the beginning and the end. He showed Moses everything. That is why, when the Lord said you are not entering the land, Moses didn’t bug out; he said yes Lord. He had already seen his end, and he saw the kingdom. These are the ships the Lord showed Moses.

“By the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again”: you would not see ancient Egypt again, for the Lord destroyed them. “And there ye shall be sold unto your enemies”: once you got off those ships you were sold to your enemies, there is the word enemies again, “for bondmen and bondwomen”, slave men and slave women, “and no man shall buy you”, meaning redeem you.

There is a new doctrine now that a lot of negroes in the world are saying, that slave ships never happened and that we were always here with the indigenous. That doctrine comes from negroes who are ashamed of the history and ashamed of the slave ships, so they try to make themselves Native Americans instead. Esau is behind it, to negate the curses.

The word Egypt is Greek. “I am the Lord thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.” Egypt is synonymous with the house of bondage. So being brought into Egypt again with ships is being brought into the house of bondage again.

sense.text:
Still dealing with Egypt in prophecy, the secrets of the times and the end he showed Moses. “And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city”: their dead bodies refers to the 12 tribes of Israel. The great city is the United States of America, Babylon.

“Which spiritually”: that is the key. It “spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt”. This is why on the back of your dollar bill you have the All-Seeing Eye of Ra over the pyramid: this is not the real Egypt, but it is spiritually called Egypt. The Masons know it, the elite scholars of society know it. It’s only Christians that don’t know it.

They will ask a Democrat, a Republican, a Christian, anybody but what this Bible says. “And that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit”: they don’t cover themselves with the spirit of the Lord; they cover themselves with the spirit of democracy, liberalism and lies. “That they may add sin to sin”: our people make the grievous mistake of adding sin on top of sin.

“That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth”: this literally did happen, but our people today have not asked of the word of God. “To strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh”: that is America. “And to trust in the shadow of Egypt!” See that part: Revelation says this place is spiritually Egypt, and Isaiah here says the shadow of Egypt.

“Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame”: the strength of Pharaoh is America today, the spiritual Egypt, and this place shall be our people’s shame. “And the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion”: trusting in this shadow of Egypt, this spiritual Egypt, shall be our utter confusion.

“They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them”: all our people that trust in this spiritual Egypt, the United States of America, shall be ashamed. A people that could not profit them, “nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.”

Who knows when the first mass conversion to becoming a Jew was? The first one is here, “in every province, and in every city, whithersoever the king’s commandment and his decree came”. This is during the Persian captivity.

There was a plot to kill us during the Persian Empire under Haman, and he was an Edomite. Queen Esther, the black woman, used her authority to turn the tables against the nations that wanted to kill us, and we got the victory: “the Jews had joy and gladness, a feast and a good day.”

“And many of the people of the land became Jews; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them.” Because of fear, many people of the land wanted to be Jews. Many people of the land said, ‘I am a Jew.’

precepts.why:

sense.text:

You open your mouth with the words of God, you are marked. So if you scared, just go on home: your wife there, she’ll lift her skirt for you, put your head in there.

You got Judaism against us, Christianity against us, everybody is against this truth; the black woman who has not repented is against this truth.

precepts.why:
This is based on Psalms the second chapter. “Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage”: the word heathen means nations. “And the people imagine vain things?”

“The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.” Then it breaks down who it is making reference to: “For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod”. So you had so-called Jewish people, converts, and the Roman government, “with the Gentiles”, the other nations, “and the people of Israel”, wicked Israelites, “were gathered together, For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.”

Meaning, whatever this Bible says is gonna happen, it’s gonna happen. That’s why it was prefaced with Revelation 2:9-10: what happened to them back then is going to happen again, and there are many other scriptures about us going through tribulation. We’re not going to go through this untouched.

sense.text: “For the mystery of iniquity doth already work”: the mystery of iniquity is the so-called white man. He is the synagogue of Satan, he is the devil the Bible speaks of. “Only he who now letteth will let”: only the Lord is letting them rule, “until he be taken out of the way”, until the Lord determines their time is up.

“And then shall that Wicked be revealed”: and now we see the wicked being revealed, and we got to take advantage of it with the word of God. Something comes out in the news, find a scripture that pertains to it; they must be revealed with the Bible. “Whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth”: the spirit of God’s mouth is this Holy Bible. “And shall destroy with the brightness of his coming”: after he’s revealed, the Lord said, I will destroy them with the brightness of my coming.

Pay close attention; I know some of y’all are in la la land. “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood”: brothers, this ain’t a physical fight that we’re up against, because physically we’re going to lose. “But against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.”

That goes with why do the heathen rage and the people imagine a vain thing; it goes with Herod and Pilate; it goes with the religious leaders meeting on Mount Sinai, political leaders praying to their idols. There’s a lot of spiritual things going on, and a lot of our people are asleep. We got to wake up, step up our prayers three times a day, pray and fast, because this is the end game, brothers, and we have not seen nothing yet. The heat will be stepped up against this truth.

Their ‘Hashem’: ha means the, shem means name. They really want to be us, smashing tablets of commandments they made up on Mount Sinai. And they held a sunrise ceremony: a sunrise ceremony goes back to ancient Egypt, the worshipping of the sun. While they’re praying to Satan, we are supposed to dig in in our prayers to the Most High. Their words sound silly, but there are codes in them: the word climate can refer to the weather or to a state of mind, a mentality. They always use words with hidden meanings, and negroes just don’t pick it up.

We’re going to touch on their witchcraft. They’re trying to access spiritual forces, and they’ve been accessing spiritual forces for quite some time; that’s what their music industry is about, their church system. That’s why we don’t wrestle against flesh and blood but spiritual wickedness in high places; we read that and scan by it, but it means what it’s saying.

“For whilst they slew their children in sacrifices, or used secret ceremonies, or made revellings of strange rites”. What I wanted y’all to see is the secret ceremonies: what we just witnessed on Mount Sinai is a secret ceremony.
“They kept neither lives nor marriages any longer undefiled”.

“Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot”: the wellfavoured harlot is Babylon the great that you read about in Revelation 17. Notice what it calls her: “the mistress of witchcrafts”. “That selleth nations”: in case you didn’t know, this is America. We’re the nations, Southern Kingdom and northern kingdom, sold “through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.”

Witchcraft is all around; we just call it Christianity. Today Judaism, Islam: it’s all witchcraft.

“And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever”: America says she shall be a lady forever; put the Statue of Liberty on the screen. There’s a lot of things going on in the world we are unaware of, but we are being affected nonetheless. “So that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it”: America does not remember the latter end.

“Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures”: America is given to pleasures, “that dwellest carelessly”: this kingdom dwells carelessly. “That sayest in thine heart, I am”: in their mind, I am, and when they say I am they mean their god; that’s what they’re trying to say. “And none else beside me”: there’s no nation that can stand beside America. “I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children”: the loss of children means citizens; my citizens here will not die.

“But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries”. The Bible prophesies this place using sorcery; we got to get that in our minds. They will not stand up and say, oh, we use sorcery. They’ll call it science, they’ll call it Christianity, they’ll call it Islam, they’ll call it Judaism; it’s all witchcraft. “And for the great abundance of thine enchantments.”

“For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me”: nobody knows I’m doing this. That’s why the Lord has Esau telling on themselves, because when you tell our people the corruption they’re doing behind the scenes, they say, ah, you’re a conspiracy theorist, you’re wrong, you’re insane. That’s what they do. “Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.”

precepts.why:
“And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee”, when this place is destroyed, because that’s what Revelation 18 is talking about: the destruction of Babylon the great, the destruction of the United States of America. “And the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee”: ain’t no marriages going to be here, no celebrations. “For thy merchants were the great men of the earth”: the merchants of the earth are the corporations, these companies.

“For by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.” The Bible once again tells you they use sorcery, so we got to wake up, brothers and sisters: the Bible is telling us they use sorcery in this kingdom here. Media, that’s major hypnosis. Take away television and black people don’t have a clue, because everything we say and speak is what we saw on TV.

sense.text: While they’re praying on Mount Sinai for climate change and casting spells, the spells ain’t gonna work against us. “Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob”: when y’all come to this truth, cover yourself with the spirit of the Lord, keeping the commandments, and there’s no enchantment that can work on you. This is why we have to keep ourselves pure and clean from sin; stop adding sin to sin. “Neither is there any divination against Israel”: there’s no divination that can work against us when we come together in the laws of the Most High God.

While they’re worried about the climate, they’re building a pipeline all under the ground from Uganda down to Tanzania to get the oil and the gas. That shows you it’s all bull crap. That oil and gas is not for the Africans, it’s for Europe; they don’t give a damn about you. All that climate is all bull crap; it’s all deceit. “And the great dragon was cast out”: the great dragon, believe it or not, brothers, is the so-called white man. “That old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan”: this is the same thing we read earlier in Revelation 2:9-10 about the synagogue of Satan, and the devil casting some of you into prison. “Which deceiveth the whole world”: you read this and think it’s a spirit coming down here whispering in people’s ears. No, it’s a man on earth manipulating nations. “He was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him”: his angels are his allies.

precepts.why:
Remember their job is to deceive the whole world. Some of y’all got good white friends. When you come into this truth, their job is to love you, overextend themselves to keep you from getting into the Bible: well, I just love you, I want to help you. That’s Satan in them, to keep you from delving into your history, your heritage, your culture. That’s a satanic move; some of you don’t pick it up, but it’s true nonetheless.

“They have taken crafty counsel against thy people”: the crafty counsel is the same as Exodus 1, let us deal wisely with them. It started with slavery, then black codes, Jim Crow, redlining, the prison pipeline, poor education, bad education: all of that goes together. “And consulted against thy hidden ones.” Now you got these fake rabbis saying Hashem just revealed to me that the seed of Israel is all throughout Africa and in black Americans, and that the black Americans are the ones infecting everything.

“They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation”: that’s their goal. They’ve spent trillions and trillions of dollars to cover up the truth that we’re the Israelites. Now it’s coming out, and now they’re raging, they’re mad: what can we do? Let’s get everybody against the black Americans so we can crush them and shut this down. That’s their plan, “that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.”

“For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee”: united against us. That’s why do the heathen rage and the people imagine a vain thing; it’s saying the same thing. Some of you think some of these nations really love us. That’s not true at all; they despise us, because we’re the chosen seed of God, a peculiar people.

sense.text: “And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies”: that’s the same thing we read earlier in Deuteronomy 28, verses 48 and 68, “in the land which thou knowest not”: that’s here in America. “For ye have kindled a fire in mine anger”: we got the Lord mad, “which shall burn for ever”, and it burned for a long time.

Remember, I’m dealing with how Esau deceived the world, how Satan deceived the world. “Arise, shine; for thy light is come”: we got to rise, and when it says rise it means wake up to this truth, and when it says shine it means teach. “And the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.” So arise, brothers, and shine; that’s what the Lord is saying.

“For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth”: darkness, sin, has covered the whole planet earth, “and gross darkness the people”: the 12 tribes of Israel are in the worst kind of darkness; we’re the ones who lost our heritage, language, culture, identity. “But the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.”

precepts.why:
As you arise and shine, there’s no action without a reaction; when there’s good there shall be evil. “Good is set against evil”: brothers and sisters, good is always set against evil, “and life against death: so is the godly against the sinner, and the sinner against the godly.”

“So look upon all the works of the most High”: look at everything the Lord has created, “and there are two and two”, good and evil, “one against another.” There’s no way you’re going to stand up in the midst of sin and declare the word of God and Satan not take notice and come against you. Some of you think you’re going to walk through the rose garden, tiptoe through the tulips; it’s not going to happen. You preach the word of God, Satan’s coming for you, whether he comes through your wife, your kids, your mother, father, your job. Wake up: you’re not going to preach the word of God and get out of this unscathed.

sense.text: “And by their secret plots”: secret, that’s not publicised everywhere. “And popular persuasions and commotions, they hindered the finishing of the building all the time that king Cyrus lived”. What I want y’all to see is there are secret plots at work. Yes, there are conspiracies, and yes, the Bible reveals there are conspiracies going on against the 12 tribes of Israel.

There are secret plots at work. Yes, there are conspiracies, and yes, the Bible reveals there are conspiracies going on against the twelve tribes of Israel. ‘Oh, you’re crazy, that thing with the food, you guys are insane, they can’t weaponize food.’ Negro please, stop.

“Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages”: when the Lord comes back he is going to strike through with his staves the head of the white man’s villages, his countries.

“They came out as a whirlwind to scatter me”: the nations are going to come against Christ to try to scatter him and destroy him.

“Their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.” See what the nations wanted to do: destroy us secretly. Who’s going to stand up on the media and say, hey, yeah, we want to kill all the twelve tribes? They’re not going to do that. Their rejoicing was to destroy the poor secretly. Let’s get our minds right.

“Being defamed”: in this truth, brothers and sisters, we are being defamed by all the nations. That’s why that fake Rabbi said there’s a problem with the black Americans, they’re the problem, they’re extremists, they hate everybody, they want to harm people. All lies and slander. So it is true: we will be defamed, and we are being defamed.

“We are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.” Everybody is going to turn against this truth as they hear it. Now don’t misunderstand: a large remnant of our people is prophesied to repent, one-third, and one-third is millions. That’s why you can’t worry about it.

“I write not these things to shame you, but as my beloved sons I warn you.” Paul said, I’m warning you, and that’s what we’re doing today. Some of you still got one foot in Christianity; you’re about to celebrate Thanksgiving next week and make up a lie while you’re celebrating it. So we are warning you what is coming.

“Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the Lord”. Esau has many secrets that they’re trying to keep secret from the Lord, but the Lord sees it all. That’s why the Lord is raising up Esau’s own people to talk about it, and raising up his prophets to reveal it in the scriptures. This is what’s going on.

“And their works are in the dark”: they’re not going to say, hey, we’re weaponizing food against you black people. They’re not going to say, hey, we created Planned Parenthood to destroy your kids.

“And they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?” Some of you, in your mind, there’s some good white folks, they is good, they love me. You simple as hell.

The one that says ‘who seeth us’, whose works are in the dark, is Esau, the so-called white man. He is the god of this world that blinds the minds of them which believe not.

As this is read, remember what that fake Rabbi said about how the black Americans are infecting the truth of Hashem. It is the same charge: “there was scattered a certain malicious people, that had laws contrary to all nations, and continually despised the commandments of kings, so as the uniting of our kingdoms, honourably intended by us, cannot go forward.”

“This people alone is continually in opposition unto all men, differing in the strange manner of their laws, and evil affected to our state”: their Rabbi says that, evil affected to their state, “working all the mischief they can, that our kingdom may not be firmly established”.

So there was always a plot against the twelve tribes of Israel when the word of God, the truth, the gospel, came out.

“And I persecuted this way unto the death”: Paul said, I persecuted this way, meaning them that followed Christ, unto death, “binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.”

Remember Revelation 2:9-10, read earlier: the devil shall cast some of you into prison; be thou faithful unto death. People read things and think, oh, that’s only for back then. No, it’s true now. We’re waking up. You think they’re going to stand back? They say that kingdom is ending, and now these guys are waking up about a new kingdom that is coming.

“Both men and women”: your wives will not escape.

“For we have found this man a pestilent fellow, and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes”: that is talking about Christ.

Sect is a group of people with somewhat different religious beliefs, typically regarded as heretical by the larger group to which they belong; and a word similar to it is cult. That’s what they said: oh, they’re a cult, these guys are a cult. Sect and cult are the same thing. That’s what Acts 24 is saying: a ringleader of the sect, or cult, of the Nazarenes.

precepts.why:
“But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect”, that cult, “we know that every where it is spoken against.”

Why? Why do the heathen rage and the people imagine a vain thing. As it was back then, so it is today: the followers of Christ are called a cult and spoken against everywhere.

sense.text: “But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost”. So if your mothers can’t understand that the Israelites and Christ are our people, they’re lost. Your mothers, your fathers, sisters, brothers, some of your wives, some of your kids can’t see it: they’re lost.

“In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not”. That goes with what was read in Revelation 12:9, how Satan deceived the whole world, and with Isaiah 29: who seeth us, whose works are in the dark. That’s Esau, that’s the so-called white man. He is the god of this world, “lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.”

“Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan”. Our comings and goings, brothers, are supposed to be after the working of the Most High God, Christ; but Esau’s coming is after the working of Satan. “With all power”: that’s their science. “And lying wonders”: that’s their religions.

“And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.” That’s our mothers, fathers, our kinsmen: they love pleasure, the deceitfulness of sin, opposed to the truth of God.

“And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie”. This is why some of our people will never let go of that cross. They will worship the feet of the so-called white man till death do them part. There’s no way we can wake them up; there’s no magic scripture; they’re beyond hope. Why? Because they despise God’s laws.

“That they all might be damned”. A sister got mad because we use the word damn. Some of you sisters are so offended at what the Bible says: just stay home, we don’t need you. Offended at the word damn, the word ass in Isaiah 1:3, he said bastard, I don’t know if this is the place for me: goodbye. Adios amigo, or amiga, whatever the hell your name is. They come out of a church where there’s adultery, pork eating, child molestation, all kind of stuff, and they come in here and go, oh, he said damn, I’m out. Get the hell out of here, nobody needs you.

“Who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness”: had pleasure in sin.

precepts.why:
This is the precept of the strong delusion in Thessalonians: “I also will choose their delusions”. Your delusion is white Jesus. Shazam. Your delusion is Mary the mother of Christ, the ever virgin. Shazam. Your delusion is Kwanzaa. Shazam. Of course. Why? Because you despise God’s law.

“And will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer”. We’re the Israelites, Christ is our people, repent of your sins. Ah, nobody keeping those Commandments, to hell with that Israelite garbage. So now the Lord said, I’m going to send them a delusion, a strong one; they’re never going to wake up.

“When I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose that in which I delighted not.” That’s some heavy stuff right there.

sense.text:
Read earlier in the class, and touched on again. “And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south”: the Ptolemy dynasty.

“Also the robbers of thy people”: that’s Herod, that whole dynasty of Europeans that converted to Judaism, as they call it. They “shall exalt themselves” as the people of God, as the Jews, “to establish the vision”: they established the vision that they are the Jews, especially through their media. To hell with them.

“But they shall fall.” That’s the prophecy. That’s why you got to be in this to win it: the Bible prophesies they shall fall.

precepts.why: “There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea”. That’s all that is needed from it. Herod was king of Judah, and Herod was an Edomite. Herod was a convert. Herod was the synagogue of Satan that tried to kill Christ when he was born. That’s them, the robbers of thy people that exalted themselves; that’s Amalek.

sense.text: “Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Thou art permitted to speak for thyself.” Agrippa comes from the family of Herod: the same race of people, the same kinsmen, the same clan.
“I think myself happy, king Agrippa, because I shall answer for myself this day before thee touching all the things whereof I am accused of the Jews”. So you had wicked Israelites accusing Paul.

This is the point: “Especially because I know thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews”. Why was he an expert? Because he grew up and learned the teachings of Israel. He learned the law, the statutes and the Commandments; he knew the culture, the customs. That’s what they did: to rule us effectively they had to learn us, and to do that they tried to become us.

precepts.why: “I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel”. So Paul was educated at the feet of Gamaliel, “and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.” That was the schooling of Israel.

“Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called” by a name that means black guy, “and Lucius of Cyrene”, which “had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.” Brought up means raised, taught with Herod.

So they went to the same schools of learning. That’s why Agrippa was expert: the house of Herod went to our schools to learn how to become Jewish, how to become a so-called Jew. That’s what happened.

sense.text:
This is regarding so-called Jewish people. “We are esteemed of him as counterfeits”: they are counterfeits, brothers. Fakes, phonies, frauds. This goes with Revelation 2:9, the synagogue of Satan, them which say they are Jews and are not.

“He abstaineth from our ways as from filthiness”: that’s why they say these guys don’t follow us. They won’t wear the dirty prayer shawl. That’s what they do: they look to see who’s waking up, the people in Kenya and Tanzania, and they send an envoy of Jesuits over there to indoctrinate them. We’ve got to abstain from their ways as if they’re s-h-i-t.

“He pronounceth the end of the just to be blessed”: we pronounce, we teach, our end is just. “And maketh his boast that God is his father”: you better believe God is our father.

Obadiah is a favorite book of the modern-day Jews, so we read about it. Their own scholars know that it is here they read the future fate of their own nation: they know they’re the Edomites.

“The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom”. Edom means red. “We have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen”: there is going to be an ambassador sent amongst the nations, “Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.” Whoever this ambassador is, he is going to rally NATO against the United States of America.
“Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.” The Lord made Edom small amongst the nations. Nobody likes them, but nobody speaks against them, because they got power.

“The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee”. If they had just left little Kyrie Irving alone, this would never have blown up like this. They said, ah, we got pride. And the Lord was behind that whole thing.

“Thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock”: the clefts of the rock make reference to Mount Seir and the Caucasus mountains of Georgia, Russia. Write that down. That’s where the word Caucasian comes from: when they say a Jewish Caucasian, or an American Caucasian, they’re telling you they come from the Caucasus mountains.

“Whose habitation is high”: they love those skyscrapers, high-rise buildings. “That saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” Meaning, who can conquer me? They’re all powerful: we have bio weapons in food, I can kill you like that, I got satellites, I got missiles, I got guns that can shoot around the corner.

“Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle”: the symbol of the United States of America is the eagle. Spain’s was the eagle, the Britons’ was the eagle, France’s was the eagle, Germany’s was the eagle, Greece’s was the eagle, Rome’s was the eagle, and now the United States of America’s symbol as well.

“And though thou set thy nest among the stars”: that’s the moon landing, the Apollo landing. That’s them sending their satellites and space shuttles into space. So don’t tell us we’re lying; we know what we’re talking about. The Bible declares it. When they landed they said, the eagle has landed: they know they’re the eagle. And Apollo is the Greek and Roman god of sunlight and of prophecy. These people are bold.

“Thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.” That’s why from that time of ’69 on up the truth has been coming out like fire.

“If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night, (how art thou cut off!) would they not have stolen till they had enough?” A regular thief would have stolen until he had enough, but not Esau, Edom. “If the grapegatherers came to thee, would they not leave some grapes?” Wouldn’t a regular thief leave something behind? Not Esau.

“How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!” That goes back to what was read earlier in Psalms 64: how they do things in the dark, how their rejoicing was to devour the poor secretly.

Remember Psalms 83, read earlier, about the nations: they are confederate against thee. “All the men of thy confederacy”: that’s NATO, the European Union, “have brought thee even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee”, their allies, “have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee”: and it will prevail against Esau, Edom over here. “They that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee”: the wound is a trap. “There is none understanding in him”: God says there is none understanding in them.
“Shall I not in that day, saith the Lord, even destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?”

precepts.why:
Here’s the precept of “All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border”, and “the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee”: because it looks like it’s all good now, but watch.

“And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast”: the ten horns are the ten common markets, that’s NATO. “These shall hate” the well-favored harlot, and that’s talking about America, “and shall make her desolate and naked”: they shall make America desolate and naked, “and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” NATO is going to burn this place with fire. It’s going to take ten nations united to destroy the United States of America.

sense.text: “But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance”: that is what is happening now, brothers and sisters. Upon mount Zion is deliverance, “and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.”

“And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them”: they shall be burnt up and destroyed, “and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau.” Who spoke this? “The Lord hath spoken it.”

This is God. This is the Bible, what the Most High says, not any racist rhetoric. These are biblical records, the scripture, written thousands of years ago, and we are not going to turn a blind eye to it and say it doesn’t say that. They portray us to the world as the threat, the racists, the anti-Semites, but the people that are going to kill them are their own people. We have no nuclear bombs and no military. All we are going to do is sit back with popcorn and watch.

“And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau; and they of the plain the Philistines”: we are going to take all those lands over there, “the fields of Samaria: and Benjamin shall possess Gilead.” “And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites”: we are going to possess them too, and “the captivity of Jerusalem, which is in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south.”

“And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the Lord’s.” Brothers, you don’t realize it, but you are saviours to the nation of Israel. That is what the Lord is saying. All praises to the Lord for that. The party ain’t over.

“And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God”: this is Esau, Edom, this is Amalek. They opened their mouth in blasphemy against God, “to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.”

They blaspheme his name by perverting the word of God, making everybody European, everybody Caucasian. They blaspheme his tabernacle, which is Israel, by taking Israel’s name. And they blaspheme “them that dwell in heaven” by saying all the angelic hosts are Caucasian. That is what they did.

precepts.why: This explains “to blaspheme his name.” “And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.” His name is the Word of God, so blaspheming his name is perverting the word of God. They perverted it so that everybody is European, everybody is Caucasian, ‘love, peace and hair grease’ for everybody, and meanwhile they are destroying everybody.

Write it down: this explains the tabernacle. David “found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.” So the tabernacle was Israel. That was us.

So when they blasphemed the tabernacle, they blasphemed us: they took the tabernacle and said ‘I am Yahudi, we are the Jews.’ That is what Revelation 13:6 is going into.

“In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen”: the tabernacle of David that has fallen is the twelve tribes of Israel. This is saying the same thing as Acts 15, with the conversion of Cornelius in Acts 10. This was the prophecy, and as it was then, so it continues today.

“And close up the breaches thereof”: he is going to bring the tribes back together again. “And I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old”: the Lord building back the twelve tribes of Israel as in the days of old.

Read on into verse 12: “That they may possess the remnant of Edom.” We are going to possess the remnant of Edom. “And of all the heathen, which are called by my name, saith the Lord”: the heathen called by God’s name are the Jews and the Christians. They say, I’m Jewish, I’m Christian.

sense.text: “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” Esau is Edom.
“And these are the generations of Esau”: Esau is the father of the ones “in mount Seir”, these Caucasians.
“And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau’s son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek.” Mark Amalek.

“These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau”, and among them “duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom.” So Amalek was a duke, meaning the chief family. That is the so-called Jewish people over there.

precepts.why: It was always Amalek that wanted that land; the victimizer was always Amalek. “And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.” They smote Israel and possessed the city. They always wanted our land, even from the time of the Judges. Amalek wanted that land, and now they have it.

“Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea.” Idumea, the Idumeans, are related to Edom. When you see the name Idumea, it is Edom, the same word.

Idumea “have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart”: they were happy to take the land, so happy in fact that they lied and said there was nobody there when they got there. Bunch of liars. “With despiteful minds”: they took it despite knowing the fact that it doesn’t belong to them.

“To cast it out for a prey”: they called their people from Poland, Uzbekistan, Czechoslovakia and Russia and said, come take some of this land in Israel, as Jewish people, as Christians. That is what they did; that is what it means to cast it out for a prey.

sense.text: “And the Lord said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book”: write this down so it is always remembered. “And rehearse it in the ears of Joshua”: teach it to Joshua. “For I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.” God said write this down to always be remembered: I am going to wipe Amalek out forever, all of them.

“And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it JEHOVAH–nissi: For he said, Because the Lord hath sworn that the Lord will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.”

What is heavy about that is that it was set from generation to generation in the time of Moses. When Saul came, Saul did not eradicate all of them, and the Lord already knew Saul was not going to destroy all of them, because it is prophetically for the future. The Lord has war with Amalek from generation to generation, so what we are going through now, brothers and sisters, is war. Understand that: this is war.

precepts.why:
This is what “I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven” goes with. Read already, but read it again: “And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining”. Who said that? “The Lord hath spoken it.”

The war with Amalek that Saul left unfinished is for the future, like Obadiah 18 says: the house of Jacob, the twelve tribes, will be the fire that devours the house of Esau until there is none remaining.

sense.text: “Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ”, the coming of the Messiah, “and by our gathering together unto him”: that is what we are doing right now in repentance. We are gathering unto him.

“That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.” It is the same message today, brothers: we can’t be soon shaken. All this going on in the earth today, all that we see, is the fulfillment of prophecy. Don’t fall off the mark. They are doing their best to hide this thing, but they ain’t hiding it.

“Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed.” That man of sin is being revealed right now. The revealing of the son of perdition is happening: they are having to acknowledge who we are, and who they are is being revealed, that they are the son of perdition, the children of Satan on earth right now.

precepts.why:
“And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?” Matthew 17 takes place after the Transfiguration. Imagine being one of the apostles there, with Peter: they had seen Christ transfigured before them, and they thought it was about to go down, that the kingdom of Israel was about to be restored.

Our forefathers were not dummies. They knew certain prophecies had to come to pass. Remember the prophecy in the sixth chapter of 2 Esdras, which the Bishop went over on Tuesday: it says who would be ruling in the end, Esau. Esau was ruling in that time, which is why the apostles thought he was going to restore the kingdom then.

The Lord left us a trail showing us who they are today. Esau is ruling right now, just as he was then, and the son of perdition is being revealed before all of us. Who is that? Edom, Idumea. He hates his real name.
